**Delivered candidate: `candidate_04`** (viewer: `candidate_04/viewer.html`, source model sha256 `39beb7b6…d8a30`). Single storey, 8 spaces, 54 boundaries, 21 openings (10 doors, 11 windows), 10 door connections; source validation pass; floor completeness complete against the single supplied plan.

## What was observed
- **Plan (1f_view.png, 10 × 20 m, north up, 27.5 mm/px calibrated from the overall chains):** outer perimeter plus every drawn divider — west wall line with rooms R2 (y 12.9–15.95) and R3 (y 8.05–12.9), meeting room (SW), east wall line with cab (NE), mid room and the SE L-shaped office; the corridor+east lobby is one continuous L-shaped space (no wall across the corridor mouth — verified when the draft compile rejected a separate lobby seed).
- **All 21 openings placed from their own marks:** 3 exterior doors (N 1600 at x 0.54–2.14, E 1600 at y 5.71–7.32, S 900 at x 4.54–5.44), 11 windows (4800 big: N, E-mid, W-south; small 1500/1200: 2 S, 2 more E, 4 W), 7 interior doors from the drawn jamb gaps. Facade counts recorded per floor/facade — all four "matches_observed_total".
- **Drawing differences resolved during drafting:** extended wallVL to the south facade; removed the phantom D_CW (the arc belongs to a wallVL gap) and declared D_meet there; tightened D_corr_A to its ink gap; corrected W_E2 from a misread 7.55 m to 4.80 m against the East chain.
- **Heights from the elevations, saved as located claims and applied:** chains read top-down from z = 4.5 m — big windows 1100|2400|1000 → z 1.0–3.4; small windows 1700|1800|1000 → z 1.0–2.8; exterior doors 1900|2400|200 → z 0.2–2.6. All 14 exterior openings carry **applied_current adopted claims** (claim_0001 N, 0002 S, 0004 W, 0006 E), each verified by a calibrated elevation overlay on candidate_04's geometry (reviews review_0002–0006); this session I corrected the North overlay direction (left = east) and re-derived the East anchors from the drawn chain ticks (px 373/911/1062/…, 10.6 mm/px) after the first East overlay misaligned, then confirmed all four facades coincide opening-for-opening.

## What was assumed (explicit in the saved BIM)
- Interior door heights 2.1 m (no internal heights drawn).
- Ceiling/storey height 4.5 m, taken as the elevation chains' common datum top; no section supplied.
- Interior door positions ±30 mm from pixels (no interior dimension chains); interior partitions ~120 mm, exterior 240 mm per "240" labels.
- All 8 room uses are **inferred** from furniture/context (lobby, corridor, offices, conference, etc.) — no printed use labels exist.

## What remains unverified / unresolved
- The pixel-to-metre calibrations (plan and elevation anchors) are caller-supplied and not independently verified.
- W_E3 and W_W1–W_W4 share their height family chains with identical drawn extents — no per-window chain is drawn (kept as claim unresolved notes); the East four openings' claim source is a whole-image citation, while the geometric verification for them is the saved calibrated overlay review_0005.
- Interior door leaf states (swing/leaf) beyond the drawn arcs were not asserted; internal door connectivity is from the drawn gaps.
- A stale text remnant: wallCW's partition source_ref text still mentions the removed "door D_CW"; source_refs aren't editable via replace_note, so it survives only as audit history (the door itself is gone from the model).
